purpose: Challenge the selected adjacent-session realized-variance stability mechanism against the complete 92-definition Campaign061 comparison catalog before reading any Campaign061 minute row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_day_over_day_realized_variance_stability_238b
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Persistence of stock-specific intraday volatility scale across adjacent sessions may represent a stable information and liquidity regime relevant to a three-session horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: 2*min(sum(r_t^2),sum(r_t_minus_1^2))/(sum(r_t^2)+sum(r_t_minus_1^2)) across each session's exact 238 within-half log-close returns

overlap_challenges.reason: The existing factor is a one-session volatility level with lower direction. Campaign061 is symmetric in t and t-1 and measures their scale stability: multiplying both sessions by the same return scale leaves Campaign061 unchanged while changing the level factor.

Campaign057 normalizes each 238-bin absolute-return vector to unit mass and measures clock-shape similarity, so it discards total scale. Campaign061 sums squared returns and discards clock shape; two equal shapes with different scales separate the factors, while permuting bins inside a session changes Campaign057 but not Campaign061.

Campaign060 discards nonzero magnitudes and compares aligned signs. Campaign061 discards signs and positions after summing squared returns. Sign flips affect only Campaign060, while rescaling one whole session affects only Campaign061.

Those statistics describe one-session temporal resolution or distribution of variation. Campaign061 neither changes sampling frequency nor allocates variation across time; it compares only total 1-minute within-half variance across two dates.
Those mechanisms depend on within-session order, adjacency, spectrum, or ranks. Campaign061 is invariant to any permutation of the 238 return positions within either session.
Campaign061 uses no peer return, market sum, peer count, dispersion, beta, response lag, or residual.
Campaign061 reads only datetime, symbol, provider, and close and has no activity, transaction-price, OHLC range, accounting, disclosure, or quality state.
Candidate49 uses causal own-session cumulative VWAP and remains future-only. Campaign061 reads no volume and creates no Candidate49 history, score, signal, execution, or milestone.
The score is computed directly from two adjacent stock-session close grids. It loads no terminal score and fits no weight, regime, filter, threshold, subset, or model.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.return_grid: 119 morning plus 119 afternoon adjacent natural-log close returns

decision.next_action: Freeze one exact coverage-first 92-comparison no-return protocol before implementing or reading any Campaign061 source, candidate, or comparison value.
